purpose: Track candidate perception datasets without treating their labels as legal conclusions.

datasets.name: Video Dataset for Safe and Unsafe Behaviours
datasets.recommended_use: Primary temporal behavior bootstrap and external evaluation.
caveats: Only two cameras at one factory are represented.
Split by camera and contiguous time period, never by adjacent frames.
Dataset behavior labels are observations, not findings under a regulation.

datasets.name: SH17 Human Safety and PPE Detection
datasets.recommended_use: Research-only PPE detector bootstrap and cross-domain evaluation.
caveats: The noncommercial license blocks use in a commercial product without separate permission.
Most source images are web-sourced rather than fixed-camera industrial video.
PPE presence alone does not prove whether a task requires that PPE.

datasets.name: iSafetyBench
datasets.recommended_use: Holdout benchmark for broad hazardous action recognition, not the first training set.
caveats: The noncommercial license blocks product use without separate permission.
Clips were curated from public online video, so source rights and domain shift need review.
Keep this set external to training if it is used to claim generalization.

datasets.name: Safety Helmet Wearing Dataset
datasets.recommended_use: Optional helmet baseline after source-image rights are reviewed.
caveats: The repository carries an MIT license, but images were aggregated from search engines and SCUT-HEAD.
Do not assume the software license resolves every source-image right.
The two labels are too narrow for general unsafe-condition recognition.

datasets.name: Construction Action Recognition Dataset
datasets.recommended_use: Candidate construction-domain evaluation after access and license review.
caveats: Dataset access is hosted through Baidu Netdisk.
The code license does not establish the dataset license.
Do not download or train until the dataset terms are confirmed.
